scope: Targeted static task model/CRUD, selected bulk/assignee/relation/bucket alternate writers, locks/permission rechecks, soft-delete/restore, bot identity/token issuance and validation, native MCP loopback/scopes, veans list/claim/update/prompt, comments/notifications/process event bus/webhook delivery, frontend task mutation and selected reconnect/cache paths; selected test assertion bodies. Not every-line, full imports/duplication/purge/attachments/OAuth/all permissions/all providers/all frontend/runtime/security/scaling certification. External Huma AutoPatch inspected separately at pinned version.

lifecycle_review.create: Project write permission and shared commit wrapper; validated indexed SQL insert with view placement/assignees/reminders and deferred events. Response positions loaded after commit can fail after successful creation; no operation idempotency key established.
lifecycle_review.select: CLI exhaustively pages task lists and filters Todo/not-done/visible incomplete blocked relations. Server related-task expansion filters inaccessible projects; ready is a visibility-limited snapshot, not authoritative readiness or capacity reservation.
lifecycle_review.claim: CLI move bucket, add configured bot, branch label and final fetch are separate requests. Duplicate membership conflicts soft-skipped; multiple distinct assignees allowed. No exclusive owner/lease/attempt identity and no dependency-ready claim precondition.
lifecycle_review.progress: Task fields, comments, branch labels and mutable descriptions provide progress/context; general updates id-only after locks/permission rechecks, no expected revision/attempt predicate. CLI timestamp check is read-before-write; partial update uses Huma GET/merge/PUT without established local storage precondition enforcement.
lifecycle_review.review: Prompt asks for summary/In Review/human close but bot CLI accepts completed and scrapped; no qualified reviewer or accepted evidence/children check in inspected completion writers.
lifecycle_review.complete: General done, bulk field and bucket transition writers; recurrence updates dates/reopens/checklist and done timestamps. Hierarchy cycles checked separately, but blocked/child readiness and review acceptance are not completion gates.
lifecycle_review.cancel: Scrapped reason required by CLI only, multiple committed steps can partially fail. Soft delete removes positions/buckets and stops timers with task/view locks; restore checks current permissions and conditional deletion state. No native agent process stop/checkpoint/resume.
lifecycle_review.recover: Committed SQL state can be reread across hosts; process-local pending events/bus/retries/poison and socket hub are not durable outbox/replay. Frontend reconnect invalidates selected caches; optimistic snapshots roll back only in current client context. No worker heartbeat, expiry reclaim or stale-attempt fencing; full purge/file/runtime recovery excluded.

external_sources.method: Read primary upstream source through web tool at the version in go.mod. GET/merge/internal PUT and generated conditional header inspected; no dependency installed or executed. Not a local candidate file hash.
